decisions.reason: The title called H the depth although def-relu-network sets depth H+2. The unchanged Statement uses H hidden layers correctly. Common-partition induction includes skip edges; each new affine preactivation adds at most one breakpoint, affine output adds none, and AM-GM gives the total-unit bound, including H=0 separately. Corrected only the title and owning manifest/contract title mirrors.

Confirmed proof gap: def-relu-linear-region distinguishes arbitrary activation cells from full-dimensional regions. For preactivations x and -x, pattern 00 occurs only at zero and was omitted by the original chamber argument. Replaced that argument with finite witnesses and a common negative shift, so every original binary pattern occurs strictly in a shifted chamber. The arrangement bound, convexity, rank bound min(r,|A|), and monotone continuation prove the original full recurrence without narrowing its Statement.

The rejection overlooks an explicitly cited proof consequence. The bounded-product lemma Proof 1.1 defines P=2M^2[Q(|x+y|/(2M))-Q(|x|/(2M))-Q(|y|/(2M))]; Proof 2.1 uses Q(0)=0 to establish axis cancellation for every real other coordinate. The theorem F2 and Proof 1.2 expressly cite that global identity. Hat products therefore vanish wherever any exact hat factor vanishes, including off support; on support all scaled inputs and intermediate products have fixed bounds. Bounded overlap and parallel subnetworks give the stated rate and target-independent architecture. No item edit is needed.

F2 omitted input-coordinate terms allowed by def-relu-network. Added those terms to the restatement. The existing proof already sets every coefficient into the affine output and its bias to zero, so it remains valid with skip edges. Ten general-position lines give 1+10+45=56 full-dimensional patterns, unaffected by the output coefficients, while the zero predictor against Y=1 has squared risk exactly one. This factual restatement defect does not invalidate the example conclusion.

The Example already compared upper bounds, but Verification 2.1 incorrectly called their quotient an architecture size ratio. Two upper bounds cannot bound a quotient of actual or optimal sizes. Replaced that sentence by the quotient of explicit positive bound functions C2/(epsilon*t) and C1*epsilon^(-1)*(1+t), with t=log(1/epsilon), which is O(t^(-2)). The target has function norm 1/2 and derivative norm 1, so both supplier theorems apply under their inherited AC assumption. Also stated that assumption explicitly and matched F3 to the actual unit Sobolev-ball interface.
